title: Automate FVTT
description: A Foundry VTT module for automated and calendared crafting workflows.

requires.reason: Provides the system-agnostic crafting + gathering data model (recipes, resource nodes, world-time-driven regen/respawn) this module builds its Keep economy on top of. No `manifest` URL on purpose: Fabricate ships almost daily as GitHub prereleases that `releases/latest` skips, so we keep the locally-installed build current via tools/sync-fabricate.sh rather than letting Foundry re-pull a stale release.

recommends.reason: Modern Foundry v13 calendar UI and real-time clock; enables real-to-game time mapping (e.g. 1 real day = 1 game month) for scheduled production.
Game-time event scheduling API (doEvery/doAt) for one-off and recurring time-based automation.
